context: Aoi joins a community chorus; tells Kenji about it.
purpose: Wife sharing new hobby with husband.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: けんちゃん、コーラス、始めたの!
lines.style: Warm, genuinely pleased discovery. Soft opening, voice lifts on the realization. Conversational pace, inviting him to share more.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: まあ、歌、唱えるんやな、ええなぁ。
lines.en: Oh, singing songs — that's lovely, isn't it.
lines.style: Soft Kansai warmth. Reflective, savoring the idea. Relaxed pace, ending note gentle and encouraging without pressing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 気軽に、皆と、歌えて嬉しい。
lines.en: It's nice to sing casually with everyone like this.
lines.style: Quiet contentment. Measured pace, almost to herself but still open. Soft smile in the voice, no rush to the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 深く、心、込めて歌うんやろ?
lines.en: You all really put your hearts into it, don't you?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, not interrogation. Kansai inflection at the end. Warm, interested tone — checking his response more than asking a question.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、熱心な皆さん、ようけいる。
lines.en: Yeah, there are a lot of really passionate people in the group.
lines.style: Tender appreciation. Soft but steady. Words come without strain, genuine admiration clear beneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: You'll have to let me hear you sometime.
lines.style: Warm Kansai ease. Light, hopeful request without demand. Relax into the trailing particle — genuine invitation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Hah, I'm so glad you want to hear!
lines.style: Bright, genuine delight. Light laugh on the opening. Bright pace, ending with warmth — she's touched he asked.
